data.name: Khileshwar
data.long_meaning: The name Khileshwar is derived from two Sanskrit words 'Khila' which means 'battlefield' and 'Ishwar' which means 'Lord'. The name signifies a powerful warrior who is the Lord of the battlefield. This name is given to a boy who is believed to be brave, courageous and strong.

This name is also given to young boys during the Karva Chauth festival, a day when Hindu women pray for the longevity and strength of their husbands.
